why: Private park over the US$50 gate: the operator's 2026 rates (ashuelotrivercampground.com/rates-reservations.html, read 2026-11-23) put its cheapest RV night at $52 (Wooded Water & Electric, 50 A, sites 56-68), with W/E/S and riverside W/E at $57 and pull-through/premier riverside at $62, one flat rate all season (May 1 - Oct 13), 2 adults; no gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: nearest Boston 118 km), not a Good Sam Park (not in the directory cache), and no member discount posted.
name: Ashuelot River Campground
note: In West Swanzey, not Keene. The Thompson covered bridge on the direct route from NH 10 takes nothing over 8 ft tall or towing: the operator directs RVs over the signed trailer route via South Winchester Street and Denman Thompson. Some sites are sold by the season; the share is not published. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site ashuelotrivercampground.com (read 2026-11-23): 22 acres on the Ashuelot River, 30/50 A W/E/S, riverside W/E and W/E/S, pull-through, 'big rig friendly', open May 1 - Oct 13 2026, reservation requests by phone or web form; site map (images/Ashuelot-Site-Map.jpg; the PDF version is dated 2022-03-07) numbers 78 RV sites plus 3 rustic cabins; 2026 seasonal sites $3,200 ('no remaining seasonal sites available for 2026'), seasonal count not published, so the nightly share is unmeasured (test 4 passes with no count; a 2-night weekend minimum and 3-night holiday minimum only). Google Maps 4.5 on 329 reviews, open, phone 603-357-5777, website listed (gm.py 2026-11-23, pin 42.87937,-72.32609 = office); RV Life 9.53/10 on 78 reviews (star_rating 5, avg_rate $52, 'Top Rated' badge). Not in the Good Sam directory. Price gate: cheapest RV night $52 > US$50, no gateway within 40 km -> FAIL (skip), $2 over.
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery (sat.py crops at 42.8800,-72.3262 600 m and 42.8810,-72.3248 240 m, both rendered, read 2026-11-23) + operator site map and photos: the Ashuelot here is ~35-40 m wide (canopy edge to canopy edge ~30 m) and wraps the campground's NW and E sides. The operator's riverside W/E row (sites 26-45, 26-29 'Premier Riverfront') sits on the river side of the campground road, the pads ~20-30 m from the water, but a continuous band of tall pines/hardwoods 15-25 m wide covers the bank in every frame; the operator's photos show the RVs among pine trunks behind a low sandy bank with a canoe dock at the launch (site-map icon near site 38), i.e. a filtered view and a short walk to the launch. The canopy band is a screen under the curation gate and the bank height can't be read through it, so on-water isn't earned: riverview (filtered, per the filtered-view rule). Inner rows (sites 1-25, 46-74) sit behind the road and are not waterfront.

fees.note: Wooded W/E 50 A (sites 56-68) $52; W/E/S 30/50 A and riverside W/E 30 A $57; riverside W/E/S, premier riverside 26-29 and pull-through $62. Weekly = 6 nights' price; monthly (28 nights) $1,092-1,302. Rates cover 2 adults and up to 4 children.

booking.note: Reservations by phone or the operator's web request form; assigned by site type, not number. 3-night minimum on Memorial Day, Fourth of July, Labor Day and Columbus Day weekends. Sunday-Thursday one-night stays are paid in full and non-refundable.

booking_source: https://ashuelotrivercampground.com/rates-reservations.html (read 2026-11-23): 'We have a two-night minimum for all weekend reservations.' 'Memorial Day, Fourth of July, Labor Day, and Columbus Day weekends – three night minimums for all sites.' 'To request a reservation now, click here, then complete and submit the form.'
sites_source: Operator site map https://ashuelotrivercampground.com/images/Ashuelot-Site-Map.jpg (read 2026-11-23): RV sites numbered 1-74 with 21A, 21B, 45A, 55A, 55B (78), plus 3 cabins; RV Life lists 78 sites.
hookups_source: https://ashuelotrivercampground.com/ (read 2026-11-23): '30 and 50 amp W/E/S sites', 'Riverside W/E and W/E/S sites'; site map legend W/E 30, W/E 30/50, W/E/S 30, W/E/S 30/50.
facilities_source: https://ashuelotrivercampground.com/ (read 2026-11-23): 'Clean bath house with free hot showers', 'Dump station and honey wagon service', 'Laundry room'; site map shows 'Dishwashing & Water' stations and water at every site. Flush toilets not stated, so left out.
season_source: https://ashuelotrivercampground.com/ (read 2026-11-23): 'Open May 1, 2026 through October 13, 2026.' 2027 dates not yet posted.
flags: Price is $2 over the gate with strong reviews (Google 4.5 on 329; RV Life 9.53/10 on 78, 'Top Rated'). Under the Google-review tiebreaker (Blackwater 753 kept at $2.79 over on 5.0/48) AWH may prefer to keep it; this record carries every add field, so flipping decision to 'add' is all it needs. The lead prompt's rule (over the gate = skip without a gateway or Good Sam) decided the skip.
Not a duplicate: nothing in campgrounds.json within 15 km or by name. Wheelock Park 4133 (Keene) was the closed city campground that led here.
Nightly share unmeasured: seasonal sites are sold ($3,200, sold out for 2026) but the operator publishes no count, and the site map doesn't mark them.

Waterfront called riverview, not riverfront: riverside sites 26-45 are ~20-30 m from a ~35-40 m river, but a continuous pine band covers the bank. The operator photos show a low sandy bank and a canoe dock, so riverfront for 26-45 is arguable if AWH reads the pines as scattered trees.
Pin is set on the central RV rows (sites 12-25), ~130 m NE of the Google office pin.
